consequence.statement: The issuer retries sooner after its linked Secret is updated instead of waiting out a high back-off timeout.

assertion.statement: Issuers now retry more quickly when their linked Secret is updated, fixing a high back-off timeout.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: Bugfix in issuer retry behaviour; no named configuration field, flag or API identity fits a subject family.; applicability: Evidence does not state a condition on configuration; it applies to any issuer with a linked Secret, with no predicate available.
